headword_sesotho.orthographic: mollo oo e seng oa molao
headword_sesotho.tone_marked: mōllō ōō ē sēng ōā mōlāō

syllables.orthographic: mol-lo oo e seng oa mo-la-o

morphology.derivation: Mollo (fire) + negative relative clause (not of the law).

senses.definition_en: An unauthorized or illegitimate fire used in worship that violates God's specific commands.

usage_example.sesotho: ...ba qala ho nyehela ka pel'a Jehova mollo oo e seng oa molao.
usage_example.english: ...they offered profane fire before the LORD.

senses.definition_en: To perceive a difference; to separate things into categories based on their nature.

usage_example.sesotho: ...e le hore ho khetholloe pakeng tsa ntho e halalelang le e silafetseng.
usage_example.english: ...that you may distinguish between holy and unholy.
